analyst_view.overall: Promoted Racing (10th, 14 pts, 11 of them at home) host in-form Real Sociedad (5th, 22 pts) at El Sardinero on Sunday afternoon. Racing's games have averaged almost 4 goals, they have conceded the most in the league (30) and have yet to keep a clean sheet, while Real Sociedad have scored in six straight league games but conceded in 12 straight away games. Racing miss Mantilla and Andrés Martín, and Maguette Gueye is unlikely after hamstring discomfort (all in the numbers); top scorer Zabiri is back from Morocco after 130 minutes. Real Sociedad miss Barrenetxea and Odriozola (in the numbers), Mamadou Sarr is unlikely to start, and six internationals including Yangel Herrera, Kubo and Óskarsson returned only on Friday, with Crystal Palace away in Europe on Thursday. No referee had been named in the pages I read.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals and take off Barrenetxea, Andrés Martín and Gueye, plus a little for Yangel Herrera, who is in fact back from Venezuela duty rather than injured. Racing have not kept a clean sheet all season and Real Sociedad keep conceding away, so a slight lean up to about 3.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.3 corners, already trimmed for Real Sociedad's lower recent corner count. Racing attack down the wings with Íñigo Vicente and Iker Luque, and Real Sociedad use Guedes and Kubo wide; nothing new changes that, so I keep 11.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.2 cards and already add Racing's high recent card count (18 in six). Neither side has anyone suspended, the game has no derby or table edge and no referee has been named, so I stay at 5.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.3 shots and already add both sides' busy recent shooting (94 and 96 in six). Two open, attacking teams trading chances is what the numbers already show; Real Sociedad's late-returning internationals and the Palace game could bring some rotation, but that is too uncertain to size, so 31.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. Zabiri and Óskarsson, both scoring regularly, are expected to play despite their late returns, as the numbers assume, and Sučić is over his tonsillitis; no change, 10.4.
